brand.headline: Water is the clearest place to learn: the body understands before the mind does.
brand.body: At Swim Fit Academy the experience is built around felt progress: a cleaner position, a calmer breath, and confidence that compounds every session. The outcome is the goal, and the method is a staged progression — from comfort in the water to coordinated performance.
brand.note: We do not publish numbers, awards, or reviews that are not verified. Anything not confirmed by management stays a direct question on WhatsApp.

start.title: Start Swimming
start.goal: The starting path: water comfort, learning to float, and controlled breathing.
start.suitability: Suited to anyone who cannot swim confidently yet, or is starting from scratch.

technique.title: Build Technique
technique.goal: The technique path: correcting position, breathing pattern, and kick quality.
technique.suitability: Suited to swimmers who can swim but want clearer execution.

confidence.title: Build Confidence
confidence.goal: The confidence path: a calmer breath, a steadier position, and more tolerance of depth.
confidence.suitability: Suited to swimmers who avoid the water or lose composure while swimming.

performance.title: Advance Performance
performance.goal: The performance path: stroke coordination, efficiency, and endurance.
performance.suitability: Suited to regular swimmers who want a sharper level.

skillPathNote.beginner: Focus on water comfort and the first controlled movements. Tell me your level on WhatsApp and we will settle the starting point together.
skillPathNote.some-experience: Focus on rebuilding the fundamentals with more clarity: position, breathing, then coordinating the stroke.
skillPathNote.technique: Focus on stroke mechanics: breathing pattern, streamline, and kick efficiency.
skillPathNote.performance: Focus on coordination, efficiency, and endurance while keeping the technique clean.
skillPathNote.unsure: No problem. Start a conversation on WhatsApp and we will explain the difference between the paths in plain terms.

method.title: Method before biography.
method.body: The full coach profile has not been published because it still needs management approval. What can be verified today is the training sequence itself.

comfort.title: Comfort in water
comfort.body: Getting used to the water, lowering tension, and finding a relaxed position.

body-position.title: Body position
body-position.body: A better horizontal line in the water reduces drag and gives the body stability.

breathing.title: Breathing
breathing.body: Weaving breathing into the stroke without breaking the rhythm.

propulsion.title: Propulsion
propulsion.body: A kick that moves the body forward instead of wasting energy.

technique.title: Technique
technique.body: Connecting position, breathing, and kick into one movement.

confidence.title: Confidence and performance
confidence.body: Being able to apply what was learned, consistently, in changing conditions.

breathing.title: Breathing
breathing.body: When to breathe, to which side, and how to keep the rhythm.

streamline.title: Streamline
streamline.body: A long, tight body line that adds propulsion and reduces drag.

balance.title: Balance
balance.body: Body axis and positional stability through the stroke.

rhythm.title: Rhythm
rhythm.body: A steady tempo that links propulsion and breathing and saves energy.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.body: Less movement for more distance and output.

method.disclaimer: General swimming guidance, not medical advice and not a guarantee of results.
method.slotBody: A reserved slot for the approved coach profile. Until management confirms it, this page stays methodology only and publishes no name or credential.

results.title: Real progress is built step by step.
results.body: Instead of vague numbers or unverified opinions, we show what can actually be tracked: a better body position, then balance, then progress toward streamline kicking.
results.storyTitle: From hesitant body position to a streamline kick with the arms extended.
results.storySubject: Minor swimmer — published without a name.
results.storyBody: Public academy material shows clear improvement in body position and balance, progressing toward a streamlined kick with the arms extended. We publish the story anonymised out of respect for privacy, and the fine details are confirmed with the guardian.
results.reviewsEmpty: Coming soon: parent and swimmer feedback after verification and approval.
results.reviewsNote: No testimonial or rating is published before it is verified and its owner has approved it.
methodology: Body position first: every later improvement builds on it.
Breathing is practised in the water before it is measured over distance.
The kick is built on stability in the pool, not on early speed.
Coordination of position, breathing, and kick comes after each is solid on its own.

answers.greeting:
Hi 👋 I am the Swim Fit Academy assistant.
I can help you find the right starting point, explain how to reach us, or connect you on WhatsApp.
Where would you like to start?
answers.programs: The site lists paths by intent: start swimming, build technique, build confidence, and advance performance. Tell me your current level and I will point you to the closest starting point.
answers.beginner: If you are starting from scratch, the first step is water comfort, then floating and controlled breathing. The first path on the site is built around exactly that, and I can connect you on WhatsApp for the details.
answers.technique: Better technique starts with body position and breathing, then the kick, then coordination. The second path on the site explains those steps, and I can connect you on WhatsApp for more detail.
answers.locations: The confirmed service area is Abu Dhabi. The exact venue and the times are set per program and availability, and I can connect you on WhatsApp to confirm.
answers.schedule: Times follow the program and availability, so we do not publish a fixed timetable. I can connect you on WhatsApp so we can agree on a suitable slot.
answers.pricing: Prices are not part of the currently verified information, so I will not guess a number. Ask management directly on WhatsApp.
answers.trial: Trial class details need confirmation from management. I can prepare a WhatsApp message that asks about it directly.
answers.ladies: Ladies-only sessions need confirmation from management before I can confirm them. I can connect you on WhatsApp right now.
answers.coach: The site explains the training method, but the full coach details and credentials need management approval before they are shown as facts.
answers.reviews: We do not publish unverified ratings or reviews. If you have a question about outcomes, I can connect you on WhatsApp to discuss it with management.
answers.language: The site is available in Arabic and English, and you can switch language from the top of any page without losing your place.
answers.phone: The direct number is 056 969 8628, and the same number works on WhatsApp.
answers.whatsapp: Of course — the WhatsApp number is 056 969 8628, and I can prepare the message for you.
answers.contact: The fastest route is WhatsApp or a call on 056 969 8628. Would you like me to prepare a message with the details you want to ask about?
answers.unclear: I am not fully sure what you mean. I can help with programs, times, prices, or connect you on WhatsApp straight away.
